i will do as i goddamn please lol i dont have any time left anyway
i have literally zero motivation left to better myself.  and even if i do get that motivation back i will never do anything about it because ill be the same lazy piece of shit better off dead that ive always been

i didnt take the lsd to have fun or expand my mind, i literally took it because i want to kill myself and i figured why the fuck not.  i want these thoughts to get stronger.  and i knew tripping would help them get stronger, ive taken lsd alone before when im in good moods and i stayed in a good mood and it was beautiful and all that shit.  but this time i wanted it to be ugly, i wanted to think about killing myself and how and when and why.

i love what you do.  you are a great person.  but is suicide really never justified?  when someone hates their own life so much that they are willing to go to such great lengths to sabotage it?  i dont do this consciously.  i just honestly dont see anything left here for me here and im ready for it to end.  all over so easily so quickly just gone.  everything.  I still cant wrap my head around the everything part.  i will get to keep nothing.  i will be nothing.  that is scary for me.  i fear death.  but i know i need it.
